domain_relevance: Features (PR draft generation from approved candidates, link-rot audit, scheduled cron runs, WebSearch discovery providers) are genuinely specific to awesome-researcher's actual domain: a Python pipeline on Claude Agent SDK that discovers, dedupes, and proposes entries for awesome-lists.
